CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_manage_specialist_object(p_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND p_name ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/(avatar|portfolio)/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}[.](webp|png|jpg|jpeg)$'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.specialist_profiles WHERE id=CASE WHEN split_part(p_name,'/',1) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN split_part(p_name,'/',1)::uuid END AND owner_user_id=auth.uid() AND profile_status='draft');
$function$

functions.name: can_operator_remove_specialist_object
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_operator_remove_specialist_object(p_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.specialist_operator_identities WHERE user_id=auth.uid() AND enabled) AND EXISTS(
 SELECT FROM public.specialist_upload_reservations r JOIN public.specialist_upload_audit a ON a.request_id=r.id AND a.profile_id=r.profile_id
 WHERE r.object_name=p_name AND a.actor=auth.uid()::text
 AND a.created_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '15 minutes'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.specialist_erasure_authorizations u WHERE u.id::text=a.evidence->>'authorization_id' AND u.profile_id=r.profile_id AND u.approved_by<>auth.uid() AND u.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND ((a.action='orphan_begin' AND u.purpose='orphan_cleanup' AND u.request_id=r.id) OR (a.action='operator_begin' AND u.purpose='profile_erasure'))) AND (
 (r.state='deleting' AND a.action='operator_begin' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.specialist_upload_audit z WHERE z.request_id=r.id AND z.action='operator_finish' AND z.evidence=a.evidence AND z.actor=a.actor AND z.created_at>=a.created_at)) OR
 (r.state='deleted' AND a.action='orphan_begin' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.specialist_upload_audit z WHERE z.request_id=r.id AND z.action='orphan_finish' AND z.evidence=a.evidence AND z.actor=a.actor AND z.created_at>=a.created_at) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.specialist_profiles WHERE id=r.profile_id))))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_my_specialist_media(p_specialist_id uuid, p_media_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v public.specialist_media; BEGIN IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='Authentication required'; END IF; PERFORM 1 FROM public.specialist_profiles WHERE id=p_specialist_id AND owner_user_id=auth.uid() AND profile_status='draft' FOR UPDATE; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='Draft unavailable'; END IF; DELETE FROM public.specialist_media WHERE id=p_media_id AND specialist_id=p_specialist_id RETURNING * INTO v; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='Media unavailable'; END IF; RETURN to_jsonb(v); END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_company_locations(p_company_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
declare
  v_user uuid := auth.uid();
  v_role text;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if v_user is null then
    raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode='42501';
  end if;

  select role into v_role
  from public.company_memberships
  where company_id=p_company_id
    and user_id=v_user
    and verification_status='verified'
    and role in ('owner','admin')
  limit 1;

  if v_role is null then
    raise exception 'verified_owner_or_admin_required' using errcode='42501';
  end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', l.id,
    'name', l.name,
    'address', l.canonical_address,
    'city', l.city,
    'phone', l.phone,
    'hours', l.hours,
    'status', l.status,
    'created_at', l.created_at,
    'updated_at', l.updated_at
  ) order by l.created_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_result
  from public.company_locations l
  where l.company_id=p_company_id;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_specialist_public_options_v1(p_specialist_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.specialist_profiles WHERE id=p_specialist_id AND owner_user_id=auth.uid() AND profile_status='draft') THEN
  RAISE insufficient_privilege;
 END IF;
 RETURN (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY section, sort, id),'[]') FROM (
 SELECT 1 AS section,0 AS sort,id,jsonb_build_object('type','service','name',name,'description',description,'from',price_from,'to',price_to,'currency',currency) AS item
 FROM public.specialist_services WHERE specialist_id=p_specialist_id AND is_active
 UNION ALL SELECT 2,sort_order,id,jsonb_build_object('type','contact','label',coalesce(nullif(label,''),kind),'href',href)
 FROM public.specialist_contact_channels WHERE specialist_id=p_specialist_id
 UNION ALL SELECT 3,0,m.id,jsonb_build_object('type','photo','id',m.id,'caption',m.caption,'kind',m.kind)
 FROM public.specialist_media m JOIN public.specialist_upload_reservations u ON u.specialist_id=m.specialist_id AND u.object_name=m.object_name AND u.state='ready'
 WHERE m.specialist_id=p_specialist_id
 ) options);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_specialists()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501', MESSAGE='Authentication required';
  END IF;
  RETURN coalesce((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',s.id,'slug',s.slug,'display_name',s.display_name,
      'profession',s.profession,'specialization',s.specialization,
      'city',s.city,'description',s.description,'profile_status',s.profile_status
    ) ORDER BY s.created_at DESC)
    FROM public.specialist_profiles s WHERE s.owner_user_id = v_user_id
  ),'[]'::jsonb);
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.specialist_gateway_erasure_inventory(p_owner uuid, p_specialist_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.specialist_operator_identities WHERE user_id=auth.uid() AND enabled) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='Registered operator required'; END IF;
 IF p_owner IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.specialist_profiles WHERE id=p_specialist_id AND owner_user_id=p_owner AND profile_status IN ('draft','erasing')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='Draft unavailable'; END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('uploads_enabled',(SELECT enabled FROM public.specialist_upload_control WHERE singleton),
 'reservations',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'object_name',r.object_name,'state',r.state)) FROM public.specialist_upload_reservations r WHERE (r.specialist_id=p_specialist_id AND r.state<>'deleted') OR (r.profile_id=p_specialist_id AND r.state='deleted' AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM storage.objects o WHERE o.bucket_id='specialist-media' AND o.name=r.object_name))),'[]'::jsonb),
 'objects',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(name) FROM storage.objects WHERE bucket_id='specialist-media' AND split_part(name,'/',1)=p_specialist_id::text),'[]'::jsonb));
END $function$

functions.name: specialist_gateway_metrics
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.specialist_gateway_metrics()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'severity',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT FROM (SELECT split_part(name,'/',1) profile FROM storage.objects WHERE bucket_id='specialist-media' UNION ALL SELECT r.profile_id::text FROM public.specialist_upload_reservations r WHERE r.state<>'deleted' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM storage.objects o WHERE o.bucket_id='specialist-media' AND o.name=r.object_name)) slots GROUP BY profile HAVING count(*)>20) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM storage.objects o JOIN public.specialist_upload_reservations r ON r.object_name=o.name WHERE o.bucket_id='specialist-media' AND r.state='deleted') THEN 'critical' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.specialist_upload_reservations WHERE state='uploading' AND expires_at<now()) THEN 'warning' ELSE 'none' END,
 'critical_over_quota',EXISTS(SELECT FROM (SELECT split_part(name,'/',1) profile FROM storage.objects WHERE bucket_id='specialist-media' UNION ALL SELECT r.profile_id::text FROM public.specialist_upload_reservations r WHERE r.state<>'deleted' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM storage.objects o WHERE o.bucket_id='specialist-media' AND o.name=r.object_name)) slots GROUP BY profile HAVING count(*)>20),
 'warning_quarantine',EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.specialist_upload_reservations WHERE state='uploading' AND expires_at<now()),
 'critical_orphan',EXISTS(SELECT FROM storage.objects o JOIN public.specialist_upload_reservations r ON r.object_name=o.name WHERE o.bucket_id='specialist-media' AND r.state='deleted'),
 'quarantined',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.specialist_upload_reservations WHERE state='uploading' AND expires_at<now()),
 'pending',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.specialist_upload_reservations WHERE state='uploading'),
 'deleting',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.specialist_upload_reservations WHERE state='deleting'),
 'definite_rejections',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.specialist_upload_audit WHERE action='definite_rejection'),
 'operator_retirements',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.specialist_upload_audit WHERE action='operator_finish'),
 'late_orphan_objects',(SELECT count(*) FROM storage.objects o JOIN public.specialist_upload_reservations r ON r.object_name=o.name WHERE o.bucket_id='specialist-media' AND r.state='deleted'),
 'over_quota_profiles',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT profile FROM (SELECT split_part(name,'/',1) profile FROM storage.objects WHERE bucket_id='specialist-media' UNION ALL SELECT r.profile_id::text FROM public.specialist_upload_reservations r WHERE r.state<>'deleted' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM storage.objects o WHERE o.bucket_id='specialist-media' AND o.name=r.object_name)) slots GROUP BY profile HAVING count(*)>20) q),
 'alert',EXISTS(SELECT FROM (SELECT split_part(name,'/',1) profile FROM storage.objects WHERE bucket_id='specialist-media' UNION ALL SELECT r.profile_id::text FROM public.specialist_upload_reservations r WHERE r.state<>'deleted' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM storage.objects o WHERE o.bucket_id='specialist-media' AND o.name=r.object_name)) slots GROUP BY profile HAVING count(*)>20) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.specialist_upload_reservations WHERE state='uploading' AND expires_at<now()) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM storage.objects o JOIN public.specialist_upload_reservations r ON r.object_name=o.name WHERE o.bucket_id='specialist-media' AND r.state='deleted'))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.specialist_gateway_reconcile(p_owner uuid, p_specialist_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_owner IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.specialist_profiles WHERE id=p_specialist_id AND owner_user_id=p_owner AND profile_status='draft') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='Draft unavailable'; END IF;
 RETURN coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'object_name',r.object_name,'state',r.state,'expired',r.expires_at<now(),'object_exists',EXISTS(SELECT FROM storage.objects o WHERE o.bucket_id='specialist-media' AND o.name=r.object_name),'media_exists',EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.specialist_media m WHERE m.object_name=r.object_name))) FROM public.specialist_upload_reservations r WHERE specialist_id=p_specialist_id AND state<>'deleted'),'[]'::jsonb);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.specialist_operator_check(p_authorization_id uuid, p_specialist_id uuid, p_request_id uuid, p_purpose text, p_resume boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.specialist_operator_identities WHERE user_id=auth.uid() AND enabled) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='Registered operator required'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.specialist_erasure_authorizations WHERE id=p_authorization_id AND profile_id=p_specialist_id AND purpose=p_purpose AND (request_id IS NULL OR request_id=p_request_id) AND approved_by<>auth.uid() AND (expires_at>now() OR p_resume)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='Independent reviewed authorization required'; END IF;
 RETURN auth.uid();
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.specialist_public_fields_version_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF ROW(NEW.slug, NEW.display_name, NEW.profession, NEW.specialization, NEW.city, NEW.description)
     IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.slug, OLD.display_name, OLD.profession, OLD.specialization, OLD.city, OLD.description) THEN
    NEW.version := OLD.version + 1;
  ELSE
    NEW.version := OLD.version;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.specialist_revision_retention_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user AND (rolsuper OR rolbypassrls)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='Trusted RLS-bypass owner required';
 END IF;
 DELETE FROM public.specialist_public_revisions r WHERE r.specialist_id=NEW.specialist_id AND r.revision_id NOT IN (
  SELECT x.revision_id FROM public.specialist_public_revisions x
  WHERE x.specialist_id=NEW.specialist_id
  ORDER BY (x.revision_id=NEW.revision_id) DESC,
   (x.revision_id=(SELECT s.published_revision_id FROM public.specialist_publication_state s WHERE s.specialist_id=NEW.specialist_id)) DESC NULLS LAST,
   x.created_at DESC,x.revision_id DESC LIMIT 2
 );
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: specialist_slug_policy_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.specialist_slug_policy_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF position('--' IN NEW.slug) > 0 OR EXISTS
    (SELECT 1 FROM public.specialist_reserved_slugs_v1 r WHERE r.slug = NEW.slug) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='Invalid or reserved specialist slug';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
